observations: The title asks hanging versus flat drying, but the actual comparison is two versus six pegs.
At 0.6 kg, equal-share loads were 0.3 kg and 0.1 kg; at 0.9 kg they became 0.45 kg and 0.15 kg.
Screenshot shows six support points and a downward arrow; it does not depict flat support or calculated fabric deformation.
Reveal says the 0.3 kg prediction held beside changed values, then explicitly limits the model to equal load sharing and directs readers to garment instructions.

complexity.conceptualDemand: Divide mass across supports while respecting model limits.

whyCool: A few small support points can carry a surprisingly large share of a wet garment.
caveat: No flat-drying or knit-stretch simulation; ideal equal load sharing only.
effort: Prediction, both support presets, maximum mass, screenshot and reveal.
bucketReason: Useful model, but title and prediction feedback overstate the demonstrated comparison.
